temperature.title: Monopolar Energy
temperature.body: DENSITY's monopolar RF uses thermal effects to influence collagen, triggering the body's neocollagenesis response.
temperature.footnote: DENSITY can deliver up to 75°C — high enough to denature collagen and stimulate fibroblasts to produce premium-quality collagen.

comparison.title: How DENSITY compares

aftercare.title: Aftercare Notes

items.title: Hydrate intensively
items.body: Skin can feel drier for around a week post-treatment as the moisture barrier rebuilds — intensify hydration.

items.title: Avoid acid actives
items.body: For about a week the skin is more sensitive — skip acid-based exfoliants to protect the barrier.

items.title: Strict sun protection
items.body: Use broad-spectrum SPF whenever outdoors to minimise irritation and protect results.

aftercare.footer: DENSITY results last at least one year. Lifestyle, sleep and skincare habits all influence longevity — ongoing care is key.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.body: Quick answers to the questions our clients ask most about DENSITY.

items.a: Anyone with mild-to-moderate facial laxity, lines, enlarged pores or dull tone. Also recommended for body laxity such as the abdomen, arms and thighs.

items.q: How long does each session take?
items.a: About 30–60 minutes depending on the area; full-face sessions average 45 minutes.

items.q: How many sessions do I need?
items.a: Lifting effect is visible after a single session. Collagen continues to form over the following month, peaking around 3 months.
Yes. The device is original-certified, with 5-step adjustable cooling and real-time temperature monitoring. Treatments are performed by registered doctors and certified specialists.
Mild flushing may occur and typically resolves within 2–3 hours. Downtime is essentially zero.

items.q: Can I be treated while pregnant or nursing?
items.a: For safety, RF treatments are not recommended for pregnancy, nursing, or clients with implanted cardiac devices.

items.q: What do I do after treatment?
items.a: Hydrate intensively, avoid acid-based actives, and use strict sun protection to prolong results.
Effects last at least one year; lifestyle and skincare habits influence duration.

items.q: How do I book a consultation?
items.a: Submit the contact form, or reach us by phone or WhatsApp.
Pricing depends on treatment area and shot count. Book a complimentary consultation for a personalised quote.
